mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_info (destination_id, opening_hours, required_time, admission_fee, age_limit, reservation, equipment_included, parking_available, contact_number, homepage_url, guide) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{openingHours}, #{requiredTime}, #{admissionFee}, #{ageLimit}, #{reservation}, #{equipmentIncluded}, #{parkingAvailable}, #{contactNumber}, #{homepageUrl}, #{guide})
mapper.select: SELECT id, destination_id, language_code, opening_hours, required_time, admission_fee, age_limit, guide FROM activity_info_translations WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId} ORDER BY language_code ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_info_translations (destination_id, language_code, opening_hours, required_time, admission_fee, age_limit, guide) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{languageCode}, #{openingHours}, #{requiredTime}, #{admissionFee}, #{ageLimit}, #{guide})
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_info SET opening_hours = #{openingHours}, required_time = #{requiredTime}, admission_fee = #{admissionFee}, age_limit = #{ageLimit}, reservation = #{reservation}, equipment_included = #{equipmentIncluded}, parking_available = #{parkingAvailable}, contact_number = #{contactNumber}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, guide = #{guide} WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId}
